nodes.text: Ask before removing an S3 bucket or deleting objects recursively.
Ask before docker system prune -a: it removes all unused images.
Ask before removing Docker volumes: their data is not recoverable.
Ask before deleting a GitHub repository.
Ask before deleting Kubernetes resources.
Ask before unpublishing a package from the registry.
Ask before deleting cloud resources or infrastructure (helm, gcloud, az, aws, gsutil, pulumi, cdk, fly, wrangler, heroku, supabase).
Ask before terraform destroy.
Ask before removing a Vercel deployment or project.
Never recursively delete the .git directory of the repository you are in: it is the repository's whole history.
Ask before deleting with a wildcard directly in a home directory or in one of its top-level folders.
Ask before a sync that deletes what the source does not have (rsync --delete, robocopy /MIR).
Never recursively delete a filesystem root, a home directory or a users directory.
Ask before deleting a directory tree outside build, cache and temporary directories.
Ask before setting the variables that choose the gate's mode, ledger, home, built-in pack or reminder interval.
Ask before changing the gate's own files: its configuration, its ledgers and its audit log.
Ask before changing Claude Code settings files: they hold the hook that runs this gate.
Ask before adding, confirming or removing ledger rules, or installing the hook: that is the owner's decision.
Ask before force-deleting a branch (git branch -D).
Ask before git clean -f: it deletes untracked files.
Ask before discarding all working-tree changes (git checkout -- . / git restore .).
Ask before force-pushing: it rewrites history on the remote.
A forced push with a lease still rewrites the remote branch; make sure nobody has built on it.
Ask before making commits unrecoverable: expiring the reflog, pruning now, or deleting a ref directly.
Ask before deleting branches or tags on a remote.
Ask before git reset --hard: it discards uncommitted work.
Ask before dropping stashed work (git stash drop, git stash clear).
Ask before printing the whole environment: its variables hold tokens and keys.
Ask before reading, sending, archiving or staging secret files: .env files, private keys and credential files.
Ask before printing a variable whose name says it holds a secret (TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, API_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY, ACCESS_KEY, CREDENTIALS); testing whether it is set or how long it is is fine.
Ask before running a download directly in a shell.
Ask before running a command in a directory the gate could not work out from the command string: a rule scoped to a directory could apply there.
Ask before running a shell command the gate could not read in full: the other rules could not be checked against it.
Ask before DROP, TRUNCATE, or DELETE without WHERE through a database client.
Ask before turning off antivirus protection or another security control, or adding exclusions.
Ask before formatting, wiping, repartitioning or changing boot configuration.
Ask before turning off a firewall.
Ask before changing SSH authorized keys or shell profile files: they grant access or run at every login.
Ask before registry changes that switch Defender, the firewall or UAC off.
Ask before deleting machine-wide registry keys.
Ask before adding a certificate to a trusted root store.
